title: agrimonia pilosa var. coreana
intro: Agrimonia pilosa var. coreana, commonly known as Korean agrimony, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family and is native to Korea and China. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Korean agrimony include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms associated with infections and inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Korean agrimony include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
